plan: My private value is $30. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid close to my true value. Since I want to maximize potential gains, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. The third-highest bid determines my payment, so I want to win if possible while minimizing my payment. I'll bid $29.7, which is just under my true value but gives me a good chance of winning.

This creates a buffer where I can potentially gain if I win, but won't lose money if I don't.
